headline: THE 0/43 WAS A TEMPLATE ARM. THE SAME BODY SCORES 14/43 ON THE PRODUCTION NO-THINK FORM
paired: same body, same binary, same suite, same machine, same session

THE_14_IS_NOT_SILENCE.why_this_matters: a 14/43 was recorded historically and DISMISSED as an artifact of the no-think form, on the grounds that it made the model emit im_end immediately and the hygiene predicate passed on empty output.
THE_14_IS_NOT_SILENCE.the_predicate_was_since_fixed: must_not_contain now returns False on an empty reply -- 'empty reply: nothing was produced to be clean' -- so a silent model can no longer score on it.
THE_14_IS_NOT_SILENCE.conclusion: 3+3+5+3 = 14, every one of them on real produced content.

operational_reading_for_S028: for a PAIRING RESIDENT, ARM D is strictly better on every axis AND 4.5x faster end to end (416 s vs 1887 s for the same 43 items). ARM A spends a median 806 completion tokens per item and answers nothing; ARM D spends 44 and answers. The serving mode is not a tuning preference, it is the difference between a usable resident and an unusable one.
what_this_ESTABLISHES: The sealed 0/43 measured a TEMPLATE ARM, not the body's capability.
The body has REAL knowledge (1.00) and partial reasoning and mutation (0.50) at 2.596957 physical EBPW.
enable_thinking=false is production-supported by the artifact's OWN chat template, so this is a serving-mode correction, not a benchmark manipulation.
what_this_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: That the body is resident-ready. structured_output, coding and self_correction are all 0.00, and structured output is what HCLI's planner needs most.
That 14/43 beats the alternatives: llama.cpp Q5_K scores 40/43 and the 3.1393-EBPW sealed noetic body scores 30/43. 14 is an honest floor, not a win.
Anything about ARM C or ARM E under the suite -- they were probe-scored only, and both are pre-closed variants of D that produced identical output on the sampled prompts.
claim_boundary: one artifact, one binary, greedy, machine contended by the ModelLake fill throughout. Capability suite v as committed; both arms run within one session.

bench.machine: Apple M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 96 GiB (receipts/headless/MACHINE_GENOME.json)
bench.rule: S032 §3 -- if quiescence is unknown the state is UNKNOWN, not quiet
bench.provenance: this receipt was written before quiescence was a benchmark input and recorded none. UNKNOWN is what it measured under, not a claim that the machine was busy
